messages.subject: problem with placement of scatterplot labels
parts:
I want to place labels by each of the points on a scatterplot.
When I do this using 'text', the labels migrate to the middle of the
plot and so are not where they should be.
I even tried laboriously typing the x and y coordinates in for each
individual point, but they still migrate, and also are clipped when
near the edges.
Tried playing with settings of xpd but that has not helped.
NB if the labels were placed exactly on the points, my problem would
not be solved, as there would be overlap and clipping, but I assume I
could then go through and respecify x and y coordinates for the
problematic cases - if only I could get ggplot2 to actually put the
labels where they are supposed to go.

Here is the script :

require(splines)

qplot(logsev,logindex,data=alldat,geom=c("point","smooth"),
method="lm",formula=y~ns(x,2),
xlab="Log severity",ylab="Log publication index")

text(logsev[1:33],logindex[1:33]-.1,labels=shortname[1:33],cex=.8,xpd
= 0)

messages.author: 3f85d5135bf072e7
messages.subject: Re: problem with placement of scatterplot labels
parts:
text() only works with base graphics.

How about

library(ggplot2)
library(splines)
ggplot(alldat,aes(x=logsev,y=logindex,label=shortname))+
geom_text(size=3)+
geom_smooth(method=lm,formula=y~ns(x,2))+
xlab("Log severity")+ylab("Log publication index")+
xlim(0.3,1.5)

I left out the points, but you could add them with geom_point()
You only seem to have one bad case of overlap (Lowe and de Lange)
